newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Mercosur to force Brazil to suspend import curbs.
newsitem.headline: Mercosur to force Brazil to suspend import curbs.

text.p: The Brazilian government will be pressured by its partners in the Mercosur trade bloc to suspend import-financing restrictions, Folha de Sao Paulo daily said on Tuesday.
The newspaper said Argentina is leading the Mercosur move against Brazil's restrictions on imports. The bloc will present its complaints at a meeting in Asuncion, Paraguay, on Wednesday, it added.
Pressured by a widening trade deficit, Brazil earlier this month decided to slap new limits on import financing for less than 360 days, effectively forcing importers to pay cash.
The restrictions prompted strong protest from the Argentine government and led the Brazilian authorities to water down the new rules for Mercosur countries while a permanent solution was sought.
Mercosur groups with Brazil, Argentina, Paraguay and Uruguay.
